data.desc: Genius Sports is a global leader in real-time sports data and technology, powering how live sports are captured, understood and experienced. As the official data partner to many of the world's leading leagues and federations, we capture the most accurate information directly from the game and use AI and computer vision to create deeper insights for athletes and richer, more personalized experiences for fans. The company works with more than 1,000 partners globally, including the NFL, English Premier League, NCAA, DraftKings, FanDuel, bet365, CBS, NBC, ESPN, Publicis, PMG and WPP. Beyond its partnerships with leagues, sportsbooks and broadcasters, Genius Sports reaches millions of fans directly through its global advertising and media platform, with properties including Covers.com, helping brands connect with sports audiences at scale.
